pending.explanation: ACK permits a 16KB writable VMA but remaps four hardware pages, exposing producer/pending metadata and data as writable. 8a6b444d4315 maps only the consumer page and leaves padding unmapped, preserving native permissions. Read-only mappings permit only rounded trailing padding beyond the actual ring, addressing the 4KB ring in netd.c. Native bpf_map_default_vmops has no fault callback, so absent PTEs SIGBUS through do_fault; VM_MAYWRITE is removed for read-only VMAs, preventing mprotect upgrades. Android BpfRingbuf explicitly uses hardware 4096-byte metadata offsets on x86. However external/libbpf uses getpagesize and combined producer+data mapping with data at that page size; in 16KB emulation its data offset differs from the hardware layout. __bpf_pgoff_fixup normalizes producer offsets but does not add the userspace metadata gap. This known compatibility question requires further resolution; it is not evidence that the interface is unused. User-produced rings and general offset normalization need review together. No emulator boot or runtime test performed.
